bagPolicy.summary: Fans can bring one clear bag per person not exceeding 12″ x 6″ x 12″ or a one-gallon clear plastic bag. Small purses or clutches no larger than 5″ x 8″ are also allowed.
allowed: clear bag up to 12″ x 6″ x 12″
small purses or clutches up to 5″ x 8″
prohibited: bags larger than the specified sizes
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is available for purchase prior to events through ParkWhiz. Consider arriving early and using sustainable transportation options like the city bus or carpooling.

rideshare.note: All rideshare pick-ups and drop-offs take place at the designated Rideshare Zone on 1st Street, between Denver and Cheyenne.

concessions.note: BOK Center offers a variety of food and drink options, including fast and casual chicken from Big Chicken, traditional arena fare, and unique offerings like boozy slushies from Slush Rush. The venue is cashless, accepting only debit/credit cards for payment.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by BOK Center, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in BOK Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The QuikTrip Box Office at BOK Center is located at the corner of 3rd St & Frisco Ave. On event days that fall on the weekend, the box office will open 2 hours prior to door time.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at BOK Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
